acceptanceCriteria: `corvint dogfood begin --plan P` with an unsorted, duplicated or out-of-range plan `intents` array refuses with a remediation that names the sorted, de-duplicated 1-16 repository-relative spec path rule, as `dogfood change` does for DOGFOOD_INTENTS_FILE; a focused test pins the message.
body: Observed 2026-10-08 binding batch L with Corvint 1.0.0-rc.2 (build 360). A lifecycle plan whose `intents` array listed three valid spec paths out of byte order (process-group-owner-v0, agent-harness-integration-v0, cem-0.2-canonical-binding) made `corvint dogfood begin --plan` print only `{"code":"invalid-intent-scope","message":"invalid-intent-scope"}`; the subsequent review and finish then failed with `local-completion-option-value-required` and `worktree-owner-mismatch`, which hide the cause. The same unsorted list given to `make dogfood-change` through DOGFOOD_INTENTS_FILE reports `missing-intent-scope` with a fix line naming the sorted LF-terminated 1-16 path rule. Expected: begin names the violated rule (sort order) and the remedy. Actual: bare code. Source: internal/localcompletion/storage.go emits the code.

completion.reason: Delivered in beamfall/corvint#700 (merge 986cec7c); focused tests, doc gates, dogfood bind/check/seal and independent review passed; evidence is the sha256 of the lane and batch build-logs at the merge commit.

title: dogfood begin: unsorted plan intents refuse with a bare invalid-intent-scope and no remediation
